title: Gumboot Throwing
tagline: Swing the boot, read the wind and wang it as far as you can.
description: Gumboot throwing (wellie wanging) is the festival contest of New Zealand and the United Kingdom. See the throw from the side, hold to build the swing, let go in the sweet arc and aim into the wind. Festival Cup, endless Distance Challenge, Practice, Learn drills, Think hints and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Pick Underarm, Overarm or Spin, then drag on the plan strip to aim into the wind.
Press and hold to swing the boot faster and faster.
Watch the grip bar: hold too long and the boot slips away.
Let go while the boot is inside the green sweet arc.
Throw further than the rival to open the next round.
